backend.role: optional persistent corpus, search, recursive discovery, retained-media, and server-side ASR workflows

limitations: YouTube can withhold captions or make a caption track unreadable from a third-party static origin.
The parent page cannot decode audio or video bytes from a cross-origin YouTube iframe, so URL-only browser ASR, scene analysis, and audio analysis are not claimed.
The static analyzer keeps the transcript and NLP result in browser memory and does not persist them to the corpus.

privacy.networkRequests: YouTube embed, oEmbed, iframe API, and caption endpoints only
